claim.reason: North_view.png vertical dimension chain (right side, x~255) reads top-to-bottom 800/1800/1000/400/1600/1000 from roof (z=6.6m) to ground (z=0), summing to the overall 6600mm height (3600mm 2F + 3000mm 1F). The 1F window family sits in the lower 3000mm zone: head at 428px (z=2.6m, i.e. 400mm below the 3.0m floor line) and sill at 520px (z=1.0m, 1600mm window height). These five 1F windows on the North and South walls share this same dimension family (identical 2400mm-wide window symbols in the plan).

decision.reason: Same crop confirms 2F window family head/sill segments.

claim.reason: Same North_view.png vertical dimension chain as the 1F window claim. The 2F (upper zone) window family sits in the upper 3600mm zone: head at 244px (z=5.8m, 800mm below the 6.6m roof line) and sill at 347px (z=4.0m, 1800mm window height). These six 2F windows (2 meeting-room windows plus 4 split office-window segments) share this identical dimension family.

decision.reason: Crop shows the door/small-window dimension chain 900/600/1500 with the small window symbol aligned to the 600 segment.

claim.reason: South_view.png door-adjacent vertical dimension chain (900/600/1500 from the 3.0m floor division down to ground) places this small window's head at 448px (z=2.1m) and sill at 482px (z=1.5m); pixel span of the drawn window symbol (448-482) matches this chain segment exactly.

South_view.png shows the entrance door symbol spanning from the 3.0m floor-division chain down through 900mm (head at z=2.1m) to ground (z=0m); the door leaf's own internal glazing bar sits at the 600/1500 split within that span, confirming head=2.1m, sill(ground)=0.

West_view.png double-leaf door drawn from ground (z=0, pixel561) up to head at pixel440; using the same 6.6m roof (pixel181) to 0m ground (pixel561) calibration, head z = 6.6-(440-181)*6.6/380 = 2.1m.
